package fixture

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
)

// A shell script written 0o755 is not the offender: the interpreter is the
// executable, and the script's bytes are never assessed by the scanner.
func TestFixtureWritesAShellScript(t *testing.T) {
	script := []byte("#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n")
	if err := os.WriteFile("tool", script, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
